summary: The bill amends the Federal Power Act to require annual long-term reliability assessments by the Electric Reliability Organization, and when generation inadequacy is found, it mandates that federal agencies submit proposed regulations affecting bulk-power generation resources to FERC for review and comment, and bars finalization until FERC determines the action will not significantly harm reliability.
